raw_response:
This plot is only a small piece, about the size for feeding my family with some extra vegetables or groundnuts mixed together. I went to school a little, so I know fertilizer helps, but one bag of NPK is too much money for this tiny plot, and I did not get a coupon this year. I will put the manure from my goats and chickens here, use seed I kept from last season, and weed it myself with my daughter. The rains have been coming well in Lilongwe, so I do not need to water it by hand.
